moments.title: UK Summer Bank Holiday

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's biggest electronic dance music festivals, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th.

angles.copy: Creamfields is ON! Kicking off this Thursday in Daresbury – who's ready for four days of the biggest electronic acts?

angles.name: Countdown to Creamfields
angles.copy: The countdown to Creamfields is almost over! Get ready for world-class DJs and an epic atmosphere starting Thursday.

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Latest
